fees.title: Standard registration fee amounts | Sapienza Università di Roma
quotes: If you earn income in foreign countries and therefore cannot submit the ISEE declaration
you pay a fixed contribution of a different amount depending on the country of origin, as illustrated below (Board of Directors' resolution of 30 May 2023).
Countries in Band A Total €300
Countries in Band B Total €700
Countries in Band C Total €1500

India; Indonesia;

admissions.threshold: Molecular Biology, Medicinal Chemistry and Computer Science for Pharmaceutical Applications: high school diploma after at least 12 years of schooling; minimum GPA 60/100; SAT or CEnT-S (any score above zero). Pre-selection is followed by Sapienza's admission procedure.

english.min_score: B2 (CEFR). Exempt with an IB, GCE or GCSE, an English-taught diploma from listed countries, or English native-speaker status.
